title: Konstruktion / Signature Graphics
slide_intent: Define a construction grammar so new subjects remain consistent and readable at the intended distance.
strategic_value: Shared grid, strokes and spacing can let DB expand its graphic family coherently.
demonstration: A 96×96 dp landmark diagram and enlarged details specify margins, vertical strokes, minimum length and spacing.
practical_value: Construct on the 96 dp base with 3 dp clear space, vertical 2 dp strokes and the stated spacing conditions.

content_islands.name: Base grid
content_islands.spec: Pair the actual-size landmark with its enlarged 96×96 dp construction and 3 dp margin.

content_islands.name: Line rules
content_islands.spec: Place orientation and distance qualifications beside the construction.

content_islands.name: Detail measurements
content_islands.spec: Arrange enlarged diagrams for stroke width, minimum length and horizontal/vertical gaps below.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source requires considering viewing distance so the subject remains identifiable.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Base 96×96 dp, clear space 3 dp, vertical strokes 2 dp, minimum length 4 dp, horizontal offset 2 dp; vertical gap ideally 1 dp or 4 dp for deliberate separation. Small elements may touch only when needed to read as one object; never horizontally flush side by side.
reference_purposes.Application: The diagrams show each measurement on a constructed landmark.

ingredient.name: Signature Graphic construction
ingredient.role: Create recognizable subjects from a consistent vertical-line system.
ingredient.application: Use the 96×96 dp ideal base, 3 dp clear space and 2 dp vertical strokes of at least 4 dp.
ingredient.scope: Official DB new-design website captured 2026-11-05; edition date unstated. Horizontal offset 2 dp; vertical gap ideally 1 dp or recommended 4 dp for deliberate gaps. Preserve the stated small-construction exception and viewing-distance judgment.
